curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach why night is harder, then high and low beam rules with their distances, then glare and extra following time
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on beams, dimming distances and glare
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on dimming distances, glare response and night gaps

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach procession right of way and passing limits, then work zone signs, doubled fines and in-zone behavior
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on processions and work zones
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on procession rules, fines and work-zone duties

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach gravel and narrow roads, then single-lane bridges, decks and blind corners, then what an autocycle is and how it is licensed
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on rural hazards, bridges and autocycles
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on gravel grip, bridge priority and autocycle licensing

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach load balance, then sway response, then towing speed, stopping and turning, then backing and the safe-tow checklist
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on loading, sway, speed, backing and checks
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on the sixty-forty split, sway response, speed cap and backing
